answer_1.quote: Natural Language Generation (NLG) is concerned with the generation of natural language text from non-linguistic input.

answer_2.quote: Following , we evaluated REG systems from 3 angles. (1) RE Accuracy and String Edit Distance (SED,  were used to evaluate the quality of each generated RE. (2) After adding the REs to the original document, BLEU  and Text Accuracy were used to evaluate the output text. (3) Precision, recall, and F1 score were used to assess pronominalisation.

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rate each text for its fluency ("does the text flow in a natural, easy to read manner?"), grammaticality ("is the text grammatical (no spelling or grammatical errors)?") and clarity ("does the text clearly express the data in the table?") on a 7-point Likert scale anchored by 1 (very bad) and 7 (very good).
